errors.text_span: shows a generally increasing trend with some fluctuations
errors.evidence: This description for the "start" line (green) is an oversimplification. While the overall trend is increasing (from 0.2 to ~0.9), it has very large fluctuations at the beginning, such as a sharp rise from 0.2 ("bb") to ~0.74 ("mb") followed by a steep drop to ~0.41 ("cf"), which is more significant than "some fluctuations" suggests.
